release_notes: Pigeon Poker 1.5.8 makes the 174-scenario preflop dataset the single source for live range charts, BOT decisions, and hero raise-size choices. The live resolver normalizes fold-only first-in prefixes and the BOT uses the same resolved scenario ID as the displayed chart. All source-defined raise sizes for the selected scenario remain visible; options unavailable to the current hand or live legal state are explicitly disabled rather than silently omitted. Regression tests cover all 174 scenarios, 169-hand frequency use across ten scenario families, and exact sizing-menu source alignment.
